title.en: An Act Appropriating One Hundred Forty Million Pesos in Payment for the Subscription of the Philippine Government to the Capital Stock of the Asian Development Bank
title.orig: An Act Appropriating One Hundred Forty Million Pesos in Payment for the Subscription of the Philippine Government to the Capital Stock of the Asian Development Bank

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4648_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, one hundred forty million pesos to be used exclusively in payment for the subscription of the Republic of the Philippines to the capital stock of the Asian Development Bank in accordance with the provisions of the agreement establishing the Asian Development Bank.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 9, 1966.
